summary: Tested new 'Categorize All' full-inventory AI categorization feature end-to-end on the live frontend (Inventory page). Button click -> polling -> success toast -> in-place table update all verified working. BOM-root items (100002693-A, 100002693-A1) correctly show 'Finished Goods'; leaf items (011004-090, 014735-001) retain their prior AI categories ('Other') and were NOT overwritten. 'Finished Goods' appears in category filter dropdown and filtering to it returns exactly 826 items, all correctly labeled. Regression: search, category filter, site filter, and pagination all work correctly post-change. Smoke check on BOM Explorer ('/') and Purchasing Plan ('/purchasing-plan') pages: both load fine, no errors - my initial smoke check hit wrong URLs ('/bom-explorer') which don't exist as routes (actual routes are '/' for BOM Explorer and '/purchasing-plan'), causing a blank page; this is a testing mistake, not an app bug, confirmed once I used correct routes.
critical_code_review_comments: bom_categorizer.categorize_full_inventory correctly excludes manual overrides from being force-overwritten to Finished Goods, and correctly cross-references bom_node_cache.found=True as a deterministic signal rather than relying on AI to guess assembly status - good design.

server.py categorize-all endpoint patches inventory_cache.items in place and recomputes the categories list so the UI reflects new categories without a live SAP re-pull - matches the stated design intent and was verified working (table updated in place after toast, no manual refresh needed).
InventoryPage.js categorizeAllInventory() follows the same resilient retry-on-transient-failure polling pattern as the other two job-based buttons (deep-backfill, refresh) - consistent and correct.
seed_data_creation: None - reused existing cached inventory/component_master data from main agent's prior run (idempotent job, safe to re-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Categorize All feature fully verified via UI (not just curl): toast showed '826 top-level item(s) set to Finished Goods, 0 classified by AI, out of 3174 total' on a re-run (idempotent, as expected since main agent had already run it once). Finished Goods filter returns exactly 826/3174 items, all correctly tagged. No regressions found in Inventory table (search/filter/sort/pagination) or in BOM Explorer/Purchasing Plan pages. Note: correct app routes are '/' (BOM Explorer) and '/purchasing-plan' (Purchasing Plan) - not '/bom-explorer'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this feature.
